rubric.statement: The answer intercepts the real text-model path by patching `litellm.text_completion` and invoking `dspy.LM("openai/demo", model_type="text").forward(...)`, so it captures the actual outbound text request DSPy sends.

The answer sets conflicting `OPENAI_API_KEY`/`openai_API_KEY` and `OPENAI_API_BASE`/`openai_API_BASE` values, then proves that for an `openai/...` text model DSPy reads the lower-case provider-specific names `openai_API_KEY` and `openai_API_BASE`, not the all-caps variants.

The answer performs a second call with explicit `api_key` and `api_base` kwargs and asserts that those explicit values are the ones passed to the outbound text request, overriding any environment-derived values.

The answer captures and prints the outbound kwargs from the patched calls, showing DSPy’s text request shape such as the rewritten model `text-completion-openai/demo` and the prompt assembled from the message content plus `BEGIN RESPONSE:`.
